title.pt: Ilhota Ipixu à beira do lago

generated.description: A compact grassy islet built in a lake, with rounded hills of lime and green terracotta, oak, birch, jungle and spruce trees, and lily pads floating on the water. Emerald block, sandstone and dark oak accents add detail. The bounding box is large, but the actual build is small, about 20 blocks across and under 10 blocks high above the water, and it contains a chest and a sign.
